title: Lyon 2021 Stage C: split-arc iso-line tracing across the surface
description: PATCH-64 split into per-stage tickets. Stage C ports metriko's gen_split_arc (visualizer/tmesh/gen_qgp_edge.h, ~140 LOC). Given a SplitElem on side s of a Tpatch and the mirrored SplitElem on side (s+2)%4, trace an iso-line across the patch interior: walk through mesh faces using TRS rotation, emit SplitEdge segments. The direction is computed from the relative parametric distances: arg = -atan((diff_end - diff_bgn) / diff_mid) where diff_* are accumulated from the patch's R values per side.\n\nDepends on: PATCH-64 (Stage A + B done), TransitionMatrix (PATCH-58).
definition-of-done: lyon2021/SplitArcTracer.java traces a SplitArc from a side-s split-elem to the mirrored side-(s+2) split-elem, returning a list of SplitEdges (per-face uv1, uv2). Unit test on synthetic patch passes.
testing-plan: 1. Synthetic 1-face patch: trace from one corner to the opposite. Verify single SplitEdge in same face. 2. 4-face cross patch: trace through 2 faces. Verify TRS rotation handled.
